site.name: BloomX Technologies
site.defaultDescription: BloomX Technologies designs and builds responsive websites, custom React applications, APIs and cloud deployments — then maintains them so your business has a dependable foundation online.

meta.title: BloomX Technologies | Websites, Web Apps & APIs Built to Last
meta.description: A web development studio building responsive websites, custom React applications, APIs and cloud deployments for businesses that need a dependable foundation online.

hero.text: BloomX Technologies designs and builds the websites, web applications and APIs your business runs on — then deploys, monitors and maintains them, so the thing you launched keeps working six months later.
hero.figureCaption: Design and engineering handled by the same small team, start to finish.

signals.title: Design and engineering together
signals.text: One team owns the interface, the API behind it and the deployment that ships it.

signals.title: React, Node and .NET
signals.text: Modern front ends on maintainable foundations, with data and integrations handled properly.

signals.title: Support past launch day
signals.text: Fixes, dependency updates and new features continue once the site is live.

intro.title: A small team that takes a project from first conversation to live infrastructure.
intro.text: BloomX Technologies is a web development studio. We work directly with business owners and product teams — no account layer in between — on the websites, internal tools and platforms that their customers and staff use every day.

points.title: We start with the business, not the brief
points.text: Before any design work, we establish what the site or system has to achieve and who it is for. Scope follows from that.

points.title: You see working software early
points.text: Design and build run in short cycles, so you are reviewing real screens in a browser rather than approving static images.

points.title: Nothing is handed over half-finished
points.text: Deployment, environment configuration and documentation are part of the job, not an extra conversation at the end.

services.title: What we build
services.text: Six services that cover a project end to end. Most engagements combine two or three of them.

work.title: Platforms we have designed and built
work.text: Described by scope and technology. BloomHR and BloomBookings are BloomX products.

approach.title: Five steps, written down before we start.
approach.text: The same process runs on a five-page website and a multi-role platform. Only the depth of each stage changes.

why.title: What you can reasonably expect from working with us.
why.text: No awards, no client logo wall, no invented numbers. Here is what we actually commit to on every project.

cta.title: Have an idea? Let’s build something meaningful.
cta.text: Tell us about your business, the problem with your current site, or the product you want to put in front of customers. We will reply with honest scope and a realistic timeline.

meta.title: Services | BloomX Technologies
meta.description: Website design and development, custom React applications, full-stack and API development, cloud deployment and ongoing maintenance.

services.title: Everything needed to get a digital product built and keep it running.
services.text: Each service below lists what it actually includes and the technologies involved, so you can work out which parts of it you need.
services.processTitle: The same five stages on every engagement
services.techText: We pick from a deliberately small set of tools we know well, rather than reaching for whatever is new.
services.industryText: The engineering is similar across sectors; the domain rules are not. These are the areas we have worked in.

meta.title: Work | BloomX Technologies
meta.description: Selected platforms designed and built by BloomX Technologies — an e-commerce storefront, an HR management system and an appointment management SaaS.

work.title: Platforms we have designed and built.
work.text: Each project is described by its scope and the technology behind it. We do not publish client performance figures we cannot evidence.
work.note: BloomHR and BloomBookings are BloomX products built in-house.

meta.description: Open roles at BloomX Technologies for frontend developers, backend engineers and cloud specialists.

careers.title: Build things that go live and stay live.
careers.text: We are a small team, which means the work you ship is visible and the decisions are yours to make. If that suits you, apply below.
